canonical_name: Integral singular homology as homology of the singular chain complex
canonical_human_statement: For every small topological space X and natural degree n, ordinary unreduced singular homology with integer coefficients is the degree-n homology object of the chain complex freely generated over the integers by continuous singular simplices, whose differential is the alternating face map.

canonical_formal_target.expression: forall (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] (n : Nat), IntegralSingularHomology X n = (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat Int) (ComplexShape.down Nat) n).obj (IntegralSingularChains X)

domain_and_universes: X : Type (small spaces in the same universe as ModuleCat Int); n : Nat; coefficients are the object ModuleCat.of Int Int in ModuleCat Int.
conclusion: IntegralSingularHomology X n equals the degree-n homology functor applied to IntegralSingularChains X.
boundary_cases: n = 0 and X = Empty are included and checked by the final example in Statement.lean; there is no negative degree because the pinned chain complex is Nat-indexed.
excluded_cases: large topological spaces in a higher universe
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory plus the instances required by mathlib's abelian ModuleCat homology construction; no new axiom or declaration is introduced.
computation_profile: noncomputable categorical construction; no executable computation or oracle is credited.
